answer: Remote attestation can bind an agent’s public key to an enclave running an approved MRENCLAVE, so a software-only VM clone cannot forge that evidence. This raises Sybil costs when enrollment also verifies genuine hardware credentials, but MRENCLAVE is not a unique chip ID: one machine can host many enclaves. A ripple of identities may gather like vessels at a wharf or spread across a tundra; per-platform limits are needed to make duplication costly.
